purpose: Teach: やみ/がかっ/もしや/ヒロシ/ひろし/ひろ/いじり/ココ

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、やみ社会の言語を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Ren, you were exploring underground-society language in your paper, weren't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Soft opening. Leaning in with real interest, not interrogating. The tone of a teacher who's read your work and wants to hear you talk about it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、影がかっ た光と影の効果を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the effects of shadow and light in how these communities communicate.
lines.style: Careful, slightly hesitant at first. Warming as he explains. Respectful to the question but gaining confidence. Breath steady, not rushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: もしや、新理論を立てられましたか
lines.en: Did you develop a new theoretical framework in the process?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle probe, not a challenge. Open posture — genuinely wondering where he went with this. Unrushed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ヒロシ・タナカ教授の論を論文で扱いました
lines.en: I built it on Professor Hiroshi Tanaka's existing work — his framework provided the foundation.
lines.style: Measured, respectful when crediting his source. Not defensive. Clear articulation of the lineage. Steady, honest tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史人物ひろし王の業績を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: That historian — Hiroshi — his achievements were quite significant. You drew on those?
lines.style: Nodding understanding. Connecting the dots aloud. Warm acknowledgment that she's following his thinking. Reflective but not distant.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ひろい地域に伝わる伝承を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I traced oral traditions across different regions — how they evolved and spread.
lines.style: Growing in confidence now. Clearer, more direct. Still respectful but less tentative. The words flow more naturally as he settles into the topic.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 文化財をいじり過ぎる修復を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: That touches on something important — restoration work that overwrites the original. You examined that tension?
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Sharp, focused. This is the real question — the ethical one. Held but not heavy. Genuine interest in his answer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、南国のココナッツ農園を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I looked at coconut farming practices in tropical regions as a case study of cultural impact.
lines.style: Steady, clear conclusion. Slight soft landing on the final phrase — not abrupt. The sense of having reached a natural stopping point. Calm, assured.
